def _write(tmp_path, name, text):
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return str(path)

def test_r11_custom_delimiter(tmp_path):
    a = _write(tmp_path, "a.csv", "x;y\n1;2\n")
    b = _write(tmp_path, "b.csv", "x;y\n1;3\n")
    df = task_func(a, b, delimiter=";")
    contents = list(df["Content"])
    assert "1;2" in contents
    assert "1;3" in contents

def _write(tmp_path, name, text):
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return str(path)

def test_r12_custom_quotechar(tmp_path):
    a = _write(tmp_path, "a.csv", "x,y\n'1,2',3\n")
    b = _write(tmp_path, "b.csv", "x,y\n'1,2',4\n")
    df = task_func(a, b, quotechar="'")
    contents = list(df["Content"])
    assert any("1,2" in c and "3" in c for c in contents)
    assert any("1,2" in c and "4" in c for c in contents)

def _rows(result):
    return [tuple(row) for row in result[["Line Number", "Status", "Content"]].itertuples(index=False)]

def test_r4_changed_line_reports_minus_and_plus(tmp_path):
    f1 = _write(tmp_path / "a.csv", "a,b\nc,d\n")
    f2 = _write(tmp_path / "b.csv", "a,b\nc,e\n")
    result = task_func(f1, f2)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert len(rows) == 2
    statuses = [r[1] for r in rows]
    assert statuses == ["-", "+"]
    assert rows[0][2] == "c,d"
    assert rows[1][2] == "c,e"

def test_r7_line_numbers_are_reported(tmp_path):
    f1 = _write(tmp_path / "a.csv", "h1,h2\nr1,r2\nr3,r4\n")
    f2 = _write(tmp_path / "b.csv", "h1,h2\nr1,r2\nr3,r5\n")
    result = task_func(f1, f2)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert len(rows) == 2
    numbers = [r[0] for r in rows]
    assert all(isinstance(n, int) for n in numbers)
    assert numbers[0] == numbers[1]
    assert numbers[0] >= 1

def _rows(df):
    return [tuple(row) for row in df[COLUMNS].itertuples(index=False)]

def files(tmp_path):
    def make(name, text):
        return _write(tmp_path / name, text)

    return make

def test_r3_changed_line_reports_minus_and_plus(files):
    f1 = files("a.csv", "a,b\n1,2\n")
    f2 = files("b.csv", "a,b\n1,3\n")
    result = task_func(f1, f2)
    rows = _rows(result)
    assert len(rows) == 3
    assert rows[0][1] == " "
    assert rows[0][2] == "a,b"
    assert rows[1][1] == "-"
    assert rows[1][2] == "1,2"
    assert rows[2][1] == "+"
    assert rows[2][2] == "1,3"
